text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...? I thought I heard someone's voice 
coming from over here—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, the statue of the Three Goddesses――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Could it be... Was it you all?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure, but— Hehe, if you 
don't mind me, I'm all ears.
